heading: Cash Drawer
bottomHtml:
Optimize your point of sale system with D CORE’s heavy-duty cash drawer. Designed for high-volume retail and hospitality environments, it features a robust metal frame, smooth-glide rails, and a secure 3-position lock. Compatible with RJ11/RJ12 POS printer interfaces, this drawer supports auto pop-up for fast cashier service. Comes with adjustable compartments for bills and coins, providing flexibility and efficient cash organization.

Ideal for: supermarkets, restaurants, retail stores, pharmacies
Connects with: Epson, Star, and other major POS printers
